parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: This is the seat part of a folding chair made of wood, typically flat and slatted for comfort and ventilation.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main sitting surface for the user, supporting body weight and ensuring comfort during use.
parts.Movement_description: It can fold upward or downward relative to the base body when the chair is collapsed or opened.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the folding chair, made of wood, forming the structural frame including the backrest and legs.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, stability, and the folding mechanism that allows the chair to collapse for storage or transport.
parts.Movement_description: It serves as the pivoting frame, allowing the seat and legs to fold together while maintaining rigidity when opened.
